name: round-2-2026-10-11
selection: Lowest mean development Brier, accuracy no worse in aggregate and Brier no worse in either chronological fold
promotion: No automatic promotion; require improved Tier 1 accuracy and Brier, uncertainty excluding regression, and a fresh prospective check

candidates.name: baseline
candidates.hypothesis: Control reproducing the current training and calibration recipe

candidates.name: stronger_regularization
candidates.hypothesis: Reduce noisy hero and pair coefficients learned on small samples

candidates.name: recent_training
candidates.hypothesis: Give recent maps more weight when team strength and the meta change

candidates.name: balanced_sides
candidates.hypothesis: Reduce incidental side-specific correlations by training on both views of each old map

candidates.name: role_interactions
candidates.hypothesis: Combine form, matchups and hero experience with specific core roles and player-rating distribution

candidates.name: nonlinear_shallow
candidates.hypothesis: Learn conditional interactions between draft, experience and actual lineup ratings

candidates.name: nonlinear_deeper
candidates.hypothesis: Capture more complex draft combinations while retaining large leaves and regularization

guardrails: No current-map result or performance in inputs
Previous results available only after finish plus 60 seconds
Fit vectorizer and estimator only on the training fold
Calibrate only on the following calibration fold
Same full Tier 1 coverage and same map IDs
Never modify data/model.json or existing forecasts
